## Technical Expertise & Core Stack

### Frontend & Architecture
- **Frameworks & Libraries**: Angular (Advanced, Micro-Frontend, NX Monorepo, RxJS, NgRx, Dynamic Forms), Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG, SEO, Core Web Vitals), React, TypeScript (Strict Typing, Complex Generics), JavaScript (ES6+).
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, SCSS, CSS Modules, Responsive & Cross-Browser Design, Component Design Systems.

### Backend & Microservices
- **Java / Spring Boot**: Spring Cloud, Microservices Architecture, Spring Security, RESTful APIs, Keycloak (OIDC/RBAC), BPM/CRM integrations.
- **Node.js & Scripting**: Asynchronous services, REST API development, backend automation.
- **Messaging & Cache**: Apache Kafka (Distributed event streaming), Redis (Distributed caching, session storage, distributed locking).
- **Storage & Identity**: MinIO (Object Storage), Keycloak (IAM/OAuth2/OIDC).

### Databases & Data Engineering
- **Oracle Database**: Enterprise schema design, SQL tuning, stored procedures, high-throughput transaction processing.
- **PostgreSQL**: Relational modeling, indexing strategies, connection pooling, complex query optimization.
- **In-Memory**: Redis (In-memory key-value cache, pub/sub).

### DevOps, Cloud-Native & Infrastructure
- **Kubernetes (K8s)**: On-premises cluster orchestration, Deployments, Services, Ingress Controllers, ConfigMaps/Secrets, Health Probes, Rolling Updates.
- **Containers & Build Tools**: Docker (Multi-stage builds, container packaging), Private Container Registries.
- **CI/CD & Automation**: Jenkins Declarative Pipelines, Automated Multi-Environment Deployments, Git, Linux Server Administration, Postman.

## Key Enterprise Projects

### 1. EPAS — Enterprise Process Automation System (NGV Group, 12/2024 – Present)
- **Role**: Full-stack Developer
- **Tech Stack**: Angular Micro-Frontend (NX monorepo), Java Spring Boot, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, Redis, Keycloak, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins.
- **Key Contributions**:
  - Architected Angular micro-frontends with shared component libraries, standardized routing, and reusable dynamic forms across multiple enterprise modules.
  - Engineered CRM/BPM workflow automation including transaction inboxes, task dispatching, and audit trails.
  - Integrated frontend clients with high-throughput Spring Boot microservices and Oracle/PostgreSQL data pipelines.
  - Maintained automated Jenkins CI/CD pipelines deploying Docker containers to on-premises Kubernetes clusters with zero downtime.

### 2. Zalo Official Account (OA) Messaging & Communication Platform (NGV Group, 12/2024 – Present)
- **Role**: Full-stack Developer
- **Tech Stack**: Angular, Java Spring Boot, TypeScript, RESTful APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis.
- **Key Contributions**:
  - Developed conversation management interfaces, message templates, status tracking, dynamic filtering, and real-time interaction modules.
  - Implemented high-performance pagination and instant search across large historical conversation archives.
  - Synchronized Zalo OA webhooks and REST endpoints with Spring Boot backend services and Redis cache.

### 3. MochiMochi Language Learning Platform (MochiMochi, 03/2024 – 08/2024)
- **Role**: Frontend Developer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SSR/SSG, Core Web Vitals Optimization.
- **Key Contributions**:
  - Developed learner-facing web applications serving thousands of active Japanese and Chinese language learners.
  - Optimized Server-Side Rendering (SSR), asset pipelines, and metadata structure, substantially increasing organic SEO traffic and Lighthouse scores.
  - Refactored legacy code into standardized reusable UI modules, accelerating feature delivery lead time.

### 4. Enterprise CI/CD & Kubernetes Multi-Environment Infrastructure (2024 – Present)
- **Role**: DevOps & Infrastructure
- **Tech Stack**: Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, Linux, Shell Scripting, Git.
- **Key Contributions**:
  - Built automated multi-stage build and container image publishing pipelines with Jenkins.
  - Configured and operated on-premises Kubernetes clusters, ingress controllers, registries, and rolling zero-downtime release workflows.
